notes.title: Details about the recent update
notes.content:
I said we won't support the game and won't make any updates. Initially we released a very buggy version, which got many bugs on it's way from web-version to steam one. 
I thought no one will play it for long, but I see there is some small community suffering with all the bugs but still playing the game. So, I've spent my Sunday evening and fixed some critical and most annoying bugs:

[list]
[*] Daily quests now should work (in order to get daily seeds, you need to spend seeds)
[*] Time desync bug is fixed
[*] Galleon and Ship of the line construction is fixed
[*] Increased monster respawn rate
[/list]
